title: Very polyester.
text: Very polyester.. The fabric looks shiny and cheap but I needed a cafe curtain quickly to match my lemon-themed vintage kitchen. I added a band of pompoms (purchased on Amazon) to the bottom and that helped them look a little nicer but it was probably more work than they deserved. Now I’m looking for a technique to dull them while my hunt for cotton shades continues.
